title: minuartia fasciculata subsp. funkii
intro: Minuartia fasciculata subsp. funkii, commonly known as Funk's cinquefoil, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the carnation family, Caryophyllaceae. Funk's cinquefoil is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and oxidative stress. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its potential to exhibit antioxidant, anti-cancer, and neuroprotective effects, making it a subject of interest in the fields of herbal medicine and pharmacology.
